opportunities.title: Video Editor Reacts
opportunities.description:
About Us

Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations.

About the Role

MrBeast is looking for a data-driven, creative, and fast-paced Video Editor to join our Content & Post-Production team working on the MrBeast Reacts channel. This role is for a master-level editor who lives and breathes YouTube culture, capable of transforming raw multi-cam reaction feeds into hyper-engaging content that keeps millions of viewers locked in. You will thrive in a high-feedback environment, balancing aggressive production schedules with a relentless obsession for frame-by-frame pacing and audience retention.

What You'll Do
  • Cut and assemble raw multi-cam reaction footage, seamlessly balancing primary talent commentary, PIP source media, and visual punch-ins.
  • Engineer high-retention video intros and hooks that immediately fulfill title and thumbnail promises within the first 30 seconds.
  • Execute hyper-fast pacing, comedic timing, and visual pop-ups, including kinetic typography, memes, and custom tracking graphics.
  • Perform high-quality sound design, including impactful SFX, dynamic music ducking, and precise audio balancing for voice clarity.
  • Collaborate closely with Lead Editors and creative teams to incorporate rapid turnaround notes and feedback loops.
  • Analyze YouTube retention curves alongside lead editors to pinpoint drop-off moments and refine pacing rules for subsequent edits.
  • Maintain clean, highly organized timeline projects in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, adhering to internal post-production standards.
  • Coordinate with the thumbnail team to ensure visual assets and key video climaxes align perfectly with channel creative strategy.
  • Stay ahead of internet culture and viral editing meta to continuously inject fresh humor and visual variety into channel content.
What We're Looking For
  • 3+ years of professional video editing experience focused on high-pacing YouTube, commentary, or viral digital content.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects, specifically with keyframing, motion tracking, masking, and dynamic linking.
  • Deep structural understanding of YouTube algorithm dynamics, Average View Duration (AVD), CTR, and retention curve analysis.
  • Mastery of dynamic sound design, audio leveling, and music curation to enhance comedic and emotional shifts.
  • A data-driven mindset that prioritizes viewer retention evidence over personal creative assumptions.
  • High feedback sensitivity, with the ability to handle rapid creative criticism constructively and pivot quickly.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, maintaining frame-by-frame precision in pacing and visual overlays.
  • Proven ability to manage high-volume workflows, including file compression, color correction, and final exports optimized for YouTube.
  • Extreme ownership over end-to-end video performance, production deadlines, and technical accuracy.
BenefitsThe Perks, Why Work On the MrBeast Team

We are redefining what entertainment and storytelling look like at global scale. Every piece of content we publish reaches millions and influences culture in real time. This is your opportunity to lead the team that decides how those moments come to life across every screen.

  • Competitive Salary
  • Generous Medical (Blue Cross Blue Shield), Dental, Vision and company-paid Life InsuranceÂ 
  • Company contributions to employee Health Savings Accounts (HSA)Â 
  • 401k Plan with Safe Harbor company-matching
  • Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
  • Company-provided technology packageÂ 
  • Relocation assistance where applicable, including travel and company-provided housing for the first 90 days

opportunities.title: Area Sales Manager
opportunities.description:
Job Title:

Area Sales Manager

Reports to:       

Director of Sales- East

Location:         

Remote- New York Metro

Status:              

FT/Exempt

Compensation:

$70,000 â $80,000 annual base salary, plus a competitive bonus opportunity. Final compensation will be commensurate with experience, skills, and qualifications.


ABOUT THE COMPANY

ROAR is redefining hydration for a new generation. In a category that has become overly serious and hardcore performance obsessed, ROAR stands for something different: hydration that is expressive, effortless, and rooted in real life. Built for people who move, connect, and live life out loud, ROAR delivers complete hydration with vitamins, antioxidants, and electrolytes - all with just 20 calories and 3g of sugar or less per bottle.


More than a beverage, ROAR is a cultural signal - bright, approachable, and fun. It rejects the intensity and rules of traditional hydration in favor of something more human: joy, spontaneity, and the kind of movement that doesnât need a scoreboard. This positioning has resonated with consumers and retailers alike driving strong momentum across both natural and conventional retail, where ROAR continues to expand rapidly and now ranks as the #2 brand in the natural channel within the enhanced water category.

 

ROLE OVERVIEW

ROAR Organic is seeking a hands-on Sales Leader to drive profitable growth in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. This role is responsible for leading all sales activities across grocery customers in the New York Metro area, including new business development, key account management, and executing data-driven strategies to expand market share and increase brand awareness.


The ideal candidate brings a proven track record of scaling high-growth brands profitably, with experience managing both established and emerging grocery retailers, as well as partners. They are highly relationship-driven, resourceful, and action-oriented, with strong communication and organizational skills. This leader excels at building and implementing the strategies, tools, and processes needed to support sustained growth.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Deliver against Annual Operating Plan targets, including gross/net sales and trade spend objectives.
  • Grow distribution and topline revenue with a focus on regional and independent retailers.
  • Execute customer sales strategies, promotional calendars, and account plans.
  • Leverage distributer incentive programs and independent retailer promotional opportunities to drive sales.
  • Conduct weekly route rides with distributor sales representatives to support execution and identify growth opportunities.
  • Develop and own a field execution strategy based on weekly trend reports, promotional planners, and merchandising opportunities.
  • Manage and execute trade spend programs to drive profitable growth and promotional effectiveness.
  • Leverage syndicated data (IRI, SPINS) to communicate compelling, retailer-specific presentations.
  • Track, measure, and analyze performance metrics, including ROI.
  • Represent the brand at regional and national trade shows, customer meetings, and industry events.

 

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum 2 years of CPG sales experience.
  • Strong understanding of the beverage and grocery landscape, including retailers and distributors.
  • Experience executing sales planning initiatives.
  • Creative, solutions-oriented problem solver with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Thrives in a hands-on, fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with syndicated data tools (SPINS, IRI) preferred.
  • Ability to travel extensively as needed.
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift up to 30 pounds.

opportunities.title: Sales & Marketing Director
opportunities.description:
The main purpose of the Sales & Marketing Director is to own and lead the company's entire revenue generation function by overseeing both Sales and Marketing as one unified department. You will be responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing strategies that generate qualified leads, improve sales performance, and drive sustainable revenue growth for Hustler Marketing.

This includes taking full ownership of the sales and marketing funnel, from generating the first client touchpoint to closing new business, while ensuring that every initiative, campaign, and sales process contributes to predictable and scalable growth. You will oversee lead generation, sales strategy, marketing channels, pipeline management, conversion optimization, team development, and departmental performance.

During your first phase in the role, you will audit our existing sales and marketing operations, identify opportunities for improvement, and personally lead key initiatives to rebuild and strengthen our growth engine. As the function matures, you will recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Sales and Marketing team while delegating execution and maintaining strategic oversight.

The Sales & Marketing Director will report directly to Company Leadership while working collaboratively with the Service Department and other cross-functional teams.

About The Role

Mission Statement

The primary mission of our Sales & Marketing Director is to build a predictable, scalable, and high-performing growth engine that consistently generates qualified leads and converts them into long-term clients.

You will be responsible for ensuring that our marketing efforts generate a steady pipeline of opportunities while continuously improving our sales processes, qualification standards, and closing rates. Through strategic leadership, commercial insight, and operational excellence, you will align both departments toward one common objective: sustainable revenue growth.

As the company continues to grow, you will build and lead a best-in-class Sales and Marketing function that continuously improves acquisition performance, expands our market presence, and strengthens Hustler Marketing's position as the leading retention marketing agency for ecommerce brands.

General Responsibilities

  • Owning the entire sales and marketing funnel from lead generation through to signed contracts and new client acquisition
  • Developing and executing the company's overall sales and marketing strategy in alignment with business growth objectives
  • Auditing existing sales and marketing processes, identifying operational gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, and implementing effective solutions
  • Building predictable and scalable lead generation systems across multiple acquisition channels, including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, paid acquisition, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Ensuring a consistent flow of qualified leads that supports the company's revenue targets
  • Improving sales performance by optimizing lead qualification, sales processes, pipeline management, and conversion rates
  • Personally leading strategic sales initiatives and key opportunities during the initial rebuild phase while remaining actively involved in high-value deals when required
  • Building, recruiting, developing, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams as the departments continue to scale
  • Managing departmental budgets, hiring plans, resource allocation, and channel investment decisions to maximize return on investment
  • Establishing clear KPIs, performance metrics, and reporting systems across both Sales and Marketing functions
  • Monitoring pipeline health, lead generation performance, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, revenue forecasting, and overall commercial performance
  • Presenting regular performance reports, strategic recommendations, and revenue forecasts to Company Leadership
  • Working closely with the Service Department to ensure alignment between client expectations, sales commitments, and service delivery
  • Collaborating with internal stakeholders to continuously improve client acquisition, onboarding, and long-term client success
  • Identifying new market opportunities, strategic partnerships, and innovative growth initiatives that contribute to the company's long-term expansion
  • Continuously researching industry trends, competitor activity, ecommerce developments, and emerging marketing strategies to maintain Hustler Marketing's competitive advantage
  • Developing scalable processes, documentation, and operational frameworks that improve departmental efficiency and long-term growth
  • Creating a culture of accountability, ownership, continuous improvement, and commercial excellence across both Sales and Marketing teams
  • Participating in leadership meetings and contributing to the overall strategic direction of the company
  • Supporting other departments with commercial insights and strategic initiatives whenever required
  • Directly reporting to Company Leadership

Position Specs

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD, with uncapped performance-based commission tied to closed revenue
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first two months (with the first two months being the trial-and-adaptation period paid at full rate)
  • Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months
  • Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months
  • Fully remote position with a flexible work schedule
  • Senior leadership position with direct ownership of Sales and Marketing strategy, budget, channels, and hiring

Requirements

About You

Profile

The ideal candidate is a commercially driven leader with extensive experience building, leading, and scaling both sales and marketing functions. You have successfully owned revenue targets, developed high-performing teams, and implemented systems that generate predictable business growth.

You are equally comfortable developing long-term commercial strategy and personally executing critical initiatives when necessary. You understand that during periods of growth or transformation, leadership means rolling up your sleeves, solving problems directly, and establishing the systems that others will later scale.

You have significant experience working within a digital agency or SaaS business serving ecommerce brands and understand the unique challenges of selling performance-based marketing services. You are highly analytical, data-driven, and focused on measurable business outcomes, using performance metrics to continuously optimize every stage of the customer acquisition funnel.

The right person is entrepreneurial, accountable, decisive, and capable of balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, fully remote environment.

Key Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience leading Sales, Marketing, or Revenue functions with direct ownership of commercial results
  • Proven experience building, scaling, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams
  • Demonstrated ability to personally drive revenue growth while also developing scalable commercial systems and processes
  • Significant experience working within a digital marketing agency or SaaS company serving ecommerce businesses (required)
  • Proven success generating qualified leads through multiple acquisition channels including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Strong sales experience with a proven track record of personally closing new business and managing high-value sales opportunities
  • Excellent understanding of sales pipeline management, lead qualification, conversion optimization, and revenue forecasting
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to measure funnel performance, interpret commercial data, and make data-driven decisions
  • Experience managing departmental budgets, hiring, resource planning, and operational performance
  • Excellent leadership, coaching, and people management skills with the ability to build high-performing remote teams
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, responsiveness, and ability to consistently meet deadlines
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams in a fully remote environment
  • Experience selling retention marketing services such as Email Marketing, SMS Marketing, or UGC services is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with Klaviyo, ecommerce marketing technology, and the broader ecommerce ecosystem is highly desirable
  • Existing relationships or network within the ecommerce or DTC industry is considered a strong advantage
  • Must possess excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities
  • Must be available and responsive during office hours (Mondays to Fridays between 3-6 PM BCN time)
  • Must consistently work 30-35 hours per week (approximately 140 hours per month)
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or desktop computer capable of attending virtual meetings
  • Must be open to receiving constructive feedback while also providing effective coaching and feedback to team members

opportunities.title: People Operations Manager
opportunities.description:
Evio Overview

Evio is a highly unique pharmacy solutions company that was founded by and works closely with health plans to implement transformative (to cost, quality, access and experience) initiatives primarily focused on specialty and other high-cost medication solutions.

In 2020, a group of five amazing Blue Cross Blue Shield health plans that in total serve more than 20 million members recognized that the way medications get to patients needs significant reformârapidly rising costs and massive system complexities are detrimental to patients and the entire industry. In 2025, Wellmark joined as Evio's first non-founding investor and sixth owner health plan. Each company made, and continues to make, significant investments to establish Evio as an independent entity to lead this transformation. â¨

Evio has advancedâ¯analytics and contracting capabilities at scale, and a suite of digital tools, to power our high-cost medication solutions. Our solutions act as a self-reinforcing âflywheelâ where each element strengthens and feeds into the next, and support an âOnly Evio can do that,â mindset and prioritization.

Evio is also a company that has invested heavily in and been highly intentional about people, team and culture. We believe we have created a very special place to work and encourage candidates to observe and ask us about our culture and decide for themselves.

Evio's Values

  • Empathy â The people our business serves always come first. We care for our teammates and put ourselves in the shoes of our health plan customers and the patients and clinicians our solutions benefit.
  • Diversity â We are committed to fostering a culture where everyone belongs and is valued for their background, experience and insights â one that encourages diversity of ideas, and is a nurturing, trusting, and accepting place for all.
  • Adventure â We are flexible, thrive in ambiguity, fail fast, and pivot quickly to get to a better answer. We celebrate wins and pivots with equal intensity.
  • Relentless â Guided by evidence and data, we are creative, curious, and unwavering in our pursuit of challenging the status quo and each other.
  • Transparency â Just as we seek to bring transparency to the pharmacy supply chain, authenticity and integrity are core to the way we communicate.
  • Excellence â We strive to raise the bar in all we do by hiring and developing exceptional talent and holding ourselves and our thinking to the highest standard.

People Operations Manager

About The Role

As People Operations Manager, you'll execute the operational foundation of the teammate experience at Evio. Reporting to the Head of Evio Experience, you'll help ensure every stage of the teammate experience is thoughtful, well-executed, and compliant. Evio is a growing company with increasing teammate support needs. This is a hands-on role where you'll serve as Evio's subject matter expert on benefits, administer people operations, manage our people systems and vendor relationships, and ensure teammates receive timely, knowledgeable support throughout their time at Evio.

We're looking for someone with a service-oriented mindset who takes pride in delivering an exceptional teammate experience through operational excellence, responsiveness, and continuous improvement. Success in this role means teammates know they can count on you for accurate answers, thoughtful support, and reliable execution, while managers trust you to keep logistics running smoothly behind the scenes.

What You'll Do

Administer benefits and support teammates

  • Administer Evio's benefits programs, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), disability, COBRA, and other benefit offerings.
  • Become Evio's internal expert on benefit programs, providing timely, knowledgeable support to teammates and helping them navigate questions and life events.
  • Resolve benefit issues by partnering closely with teammates, brokers, carriers, and vendors.
  • Administer leaves of absence and workplace accommodations.
  • Manage relationships with benefits brokers, vendors, and other external partners.
  • Recommend improvements to benefits and people policies based on teammate feedback, operational insights, and evolving business needs.

Own people systems and operational excellence

  • Own the day-to-day administration of people systems, including Justworks and future people technology platforms.
  • Ensure people systems, teammate records, workflows, and documentation remain accurate, organized, and up to date.
  • Document, maintain, and continuously improve people processes to support consistency and scale.
  • Maintain SOC-related people operations controls and documentation.
  • Identify practical opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve operational processes.

Support policies and compliance

  • Help maintain the teammate handbook and people policies.
  • Ensure required employment notices and documentation remain current.
  • Partner with Legal and the Head of Evio Experience to support employment law compliance.
  • Maintain documentation standards and consistent employment practices.
  • Help ensure leave, accommodation, and employment practices are administered consistently and compliantly.

Coordinate onboarding and offboarding

  • Execute the operational aspects of the teammate journey from pre-boarding through offboarding.
  • Coordinate pre-boarding logistics to ensure new teammates have a seamless start.
  • Manage offboarding processes, documentation, and logistics.
  • Administer company calendars, and recurring people operations processes.

Your Skills And Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in people operations, human resources, teammate experience, benefits administration, HR compliance, or a closely related operational role. We welcome candidates whose experience may come from a variety of backgrounds, provided they've demonstrated ownership of core people responsibilities such as benefits administration, people systems, HR compliance, and supporting the teammate lifecycle in a growing organization.
  • Strong experience administering employee benefits and supporting teammates through benefit questions, life events, and leave administration.
  • Experience managing people systems and maintaining accurate teammate records and workflows.
  • Experience managing relationships with external vendors, brokers, and service providers.
  • Working knowledge of human resources practices, employment law, HR compliance, accommodations, documentation standards, and leave administration.
  • Experience documenting and improving operational processes in a growing organization.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to explain complex information clearly and compassionately.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion, sound judgment, and professionalism.
  • A service-oriented mindset with a genuine desire to support teammates and help create a company and culture we're all proud to be part of.

Salary considerations

The anticipated salary range for this position is $100,000â$130,000 annually plus additional variable compensation.

Atâ¯Evio,â¯weâreâ¯committed to building a competitive compensation package to honor the value our teammates bring as well as attract andâ¯retainâ¯top talent that is aligned with our culture,â¯missionâ¯and values. Compensation includes base pay (range shown) and could include other variable compensation opportunitiesâ¯depending on job seniority, location, and date of hire.

Please note that the base pay information shown is a general guideline for the job responsibilities and qualifications listed. Salary decisions are based on candidateâ¯experience, andâ¯market and business considerations.â¯

Evio Benefits

Evio offers a number of attractive benefits to eligible teammates including health insurance, retirement savings, life and disability insurance, paid and unpaid time off, and other benefits to make sure Evio teammates and families are well supported.

  • Great Health Insurance The company pays 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for teammates, and 50% for dependents.
  • 401K Match Evio matches 100% of teammate contribution up to 5% of salary, subject to IRS limits.
  • Time Off We have a flexible vacation policy for teammates to unplug and recharge when you need it. There is no minimum or maximum amount of vacation allowed per year, and there is no payment in consideration for unused vacation. Vacation is to be used at your discretion, with approval of leadership.
  • Parental Leave Generous paid leave for new parents (includes birth and non-birth parents).

Fraud Notice

Weâve Recently Learned Of Fraudulent Job Postings And Individuals Falsely Claiming To Represent Evio. Protecting Our Candidates Is Incredibly Important To Us, And We Want To Share a Few Reminders

  • All official communication will come from an email ending in @evio.com.
  • We will never conduct text-only interviews (Teams, SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram, etc.).
  • We will never ask for payment, gift cards, fees, or purchases of any kind.
  • We will never request sensitive financial information during the recruiting process.
  • Our open roles are posted only on our official website, LinkedIn, and Greenhouse job board.

If you believe youâve encountered a scam, you can also report it to the Federal Trade Commission or the Internet Crime Complaint Center. Thank you for your care and vigilance â weâre grateful to everyone who helps keep our community safe.

Information Disclosure

We value transparency in our hiring process and want applicants to understand how your information is used.

We collect and use personal information you provide during the application process such as your resume, employment history, education, interview responses, and other job-related information, to evaluate your qualifications for employment. This may also include limited technical and interaction data, such as IP address and device or browser information.

We may use automated or AI-assisted tools to help review applications, identify qualified candidates, and detect or investigate potentially fraudulent or deceptive activity. Human reviewers remain involved, and these tools support, not replace, human judgment.

These measures support a fair and secure hiring process for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation, please inform us when invited to interview.

California privacy noticeâ¨Consistent with California law, we use this information for recruiting, hiring, and related business purposes, including evaluating your candidacy and improving our hiring processes.

Ajaia is a fast-growing AI consultancy and product studio that helps organizations move from experimentation to real results. We work across AI Strategy, AI Engineering and Automation, Workforce Enablement, and Custom Product Development, and we build our own AI products alongside client work.

Our mission is to help organizations win the AI moment.

About The Role

You will own content execution across social, short and long-form video, podcast workflows, and training video.

You own the calendar, the output, and the numbers. You write platform-native content for LinkedIn, X, and email. You edit video people actually finish watching. You build the AI-assisted workflows that make all of it faster without making it generic.

This role is AI-forward by design. You will use AI daily for ideation, scripting, editing, repurposing, and QA. We expect you to already work this way.

What You Will Do

  • Own social content operations from planning to publishing to performance reporting
  • Write platform-native content for LinkedIn, X, and email newsletters
  • Edit short and long-form video for marketing and thought leadership
  • Run podcast post-production, clips, and distribution

  • Build reusable AI-assisted workflows for scripting, editing, and repurposing
  • Hold the line on brand voice and quality across every output

  • 3 to 5 years in social content, video editing, or multi-channel content management
  • Demonstrated ownership of publishing workflows and deadlines
  • Strong writing for LinkedIn, X, and email newsletter formats
  • Experience editing training or educational video

Portfolio, required. Applications without samples will not be reviewed: LinkedIn, X, email newsletter, and video editing samples covering both short and long-form.

Schedule. Fully remote, with required overlap 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.

Technical. Wired internet 100 Mbps minimum. Intel Core i7, Ryzen 7, or Apple Silicon with 16GB RAM and 256GB free storage. Windows 11 or current macOS. 1080p webcam and mic. Backup power and internet.

You will own a broad content function spanning social, video, podcast, and training, not one narrow slice of it. You will build thought leadership at a company doing AI implementation work that reaches production, and design scalable content systems rather than grinding out one-off assets.

Let's build what's next.

opportunities.title: VP Revenue
opportunities.description:
Mongoose is the leading AI Engagement Platform in higher education. Colleges and universities use us to increase enrollment, retention, and fundraising — without adding staff.


We have the product and the customers. What we don't have yet is a revenue engine to match. That's this role. As VP of Revenue, you own it end to end — new business, client success, account management, and, most importantly, the system that ties them together. Your job is to make it simple and run it with discipline.



What You'll Do


  • Own all of revenue. The whole revenue org reports to you — one team, one leader. New business, client success, and account management are the front line, with enablement and operations behind them — the training and tools that set them up to win. It all serves one goal: grow ARR — by winning new business and helping our customers succeed. So you're measured on two things: new ARR and gross retention.




  • Build a simple, repeatable selling system. One clear path from first call to close to renewal — the stages, standards, and playbooks the whole team runs the same way. Make it so clear that reps know what good looks like and spend their time selling, not guessing. Done right, it shows up in forecasts you can trust, faster deals, and better conversion at every step.




  • Grow the people who sell it. Our reps are early in their careers and hungry, so growing them isn't a side project — it's the job. You build the system that does it: ramp, enablement, and a steady coaching cadence. And you're in it, not above it — in the deals and the reviews, helping close and coaching the fundamentals in the moment, not from a slide at quarter's end. The result is reps who sell with real confidence and conviction: they know how to win, and they believe they will.




  • Move us up-market. Our next stage of growth is in bigger deals. You know where the real opportunity lives in higher ed, and you focus the team there — raising the ACV we pursue, building around the highest-value accounts, and growing the ones with real upside. It takes sharp market judgment, a head for the numbers, and the discipline to say no to deals that aren't worth the team's time.




  • Run revenue like an AI company. Most revenue orgs still operate the way they did decades ago — we won't. We sell AI for a living, and the whole company is getting far more efficient, accurate, and effective by letting AI do the manual work. That takes more than watching for the next AI tool — it takes imagination: you picture how technology could reinvent the work, then we build it.






What You'll Bring


  • You've run a full revenue org — new business and retention both — and carried a number yourself, not just managed people who carried theirs.




  • When a number gets missed, you go straight to the funnel math — pipeline, conversion, time-in-stage — not the story about why.




  • You've built a selling system that works — whether you stood it up from scratch or overhauled a broken one inside an established org.




  • You're a real coach. You've taken early-career reps and turned them into closers — hands-on, not from a dashboard.




  • You think in unit economics and read a market fast. You've moved a team toward bigger, better deals, and had the discipline to walk from the rest.




  • You're already using AI to reinvent how you work, and you don't wait for permission to push it further.




  • Higher ed or EdTech experience is a strong plus, not a must. The market has real nuance — if you haven't lived in it, show us how you'll close the gap fast.






How We WorkRevenue doesn't run in isolation. You're a key member of our senior leadership team — leading revenue alongside the CEO, partnering with Product and Marketing on go-to-market, and with Finance and People to run the business. Tight feedback loops, honest calls, shared decisions. We hold each other accountable to the plan — and to the whole outcome, not just our own lane.


More About Mongoose

1,000+ higher ed institutions already trust Mongoose — built to give their teams exponentially more capacity across the systems they already run.


AI handles the routine, so people can focus on the work that actually moves students forward — more applications completed, more students retained, more donors reached. Same team. Much bigger impact.



What We Offer

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401K with company match: 100% of the 1st 3% and 50% of the next 2%

  • Flexible PTO

  • Competitive Leave Policies

  • 13 paid holidays, including a week off between Christmas and New Year’s




The BasicsRemote, anywhere in the US. Some travel — for customers, for big deals, and for time together as a team.
 
At Mongoose, we believe that diversity drives innovation, and inclusion builds stronger teams. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know—we’re here to help.

opportunities.description:
JOB PURPOSE:

We are seeking an ambitious and commercially minded Junior Account Manager to join our Sales team and support the management of key national retail accounts. Reporting to the National Account Manager, you will play an integral role in analyzing sales data, developing strategic customer partnerships, driving profitable sales growth, and delivering exceptional customer service across a portfolio of grocery/retail customers.


The ideal candidate for this role will have sales analytics experience within the consumer/beauty product industry. In addition, this individual will support smaller grocery accounts working closely with the National Sales Manager to whom the position reports.


This role provides an excellent opportunity to develop a career in Account Management. You will work collaboratively with internal teams including Marketing, Category, Supply Chain, Finance, Customer Service, and Demand Planning to execute customer strategies, deliver business objectives, and support the continued growth of our wholesale retail partnerships.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Achievement of targets. Monthly, quarterly, annual sales and profit targets.
  • Ensure flawless implementation of all new product development and achievement of required distribution objectives.
  • Responsibility for the development, maintenance, and implementation of all administration.
  • Preparing reviews for all accounts within his/her responsibility, including strategic planning and resource allocation to achieve account objectives.
  • Build multi-level contacts and develop productive business relationships with external customers
  • Manage and control all promotion expenditure within your responsibility in line with the companyâs guidelines, to ensure an optimum return on investment.
  • Develop and improve tools and systems to monitor the marketplace, our brands and competitorâs performance.
  • Effectively collaborate and coordinate activity within internal departments, category, customer marketing, finance, and customer services to deliver companyâs business priorities.
  • Own and drive initiatives which deliver improved levels of customer service and satisfaction.
  • Responsibility for ensuring identified expenses are kept within budgeted guidelines and completed on time as required by company policy.
  • Ensure personal developments by implementing agreed training and development objectives
  • Drive Off-Shelf Promotional Programs to increase sales through off-shelf promotional programs by developing profitable display features and winning feature space within retailer opportunities
  • Implement Holiday Program to grow sales and profit through Global Sourcing initiative. Pursue opportunity to expand sales in Seasonal category by developing optimal offering, navigating online bid process, guide organization through retailer requirements and timeline of direct import program.
  • Share and Leverage Category Success Stories. Serve as âthought leadershipâ to the PPI Trade Marketing & Sales organization by regularly share product / category success stories to use with other retailers to drive incremental sales across the organization.
  • Identify business opportunities through collaboration and optimize profitability through negotiation with retailer and FBB Marketing / PD organization. Translate those business opportunities into account-specific strategies and tactics that drive market share and growth.
  • Integrate and analyze multiple data sources to create strategies and programs that deliver win-win outcomes through innovation and collaboration with the account team
  • Connect, develop, and maintain relationships with key Retailer Organization contacts, including Buyers, Merchants, Modular Development, Replenishment, Transportation, and Logistics. Cultivate account relationships to understand customer needs and goals to capitalize on business opportunities
  • Build rapport, communicate strategy, and negotiate with customer decision makers, resulting in increased distribution, shelving, merchandising, and improved marketing of FBB brands.
  • Analyze sales trends and supply chain efficiencies to make recommendations to maximize opportunities, while analyzing forecasting metrics and data to ensure accuracy targets are met.
  • Track and report monthly forecast versus actual POS reports, pro-actively addressing potential issues with logistics and inventory levels using monthly key performance indicators (fill rate, in-stock % and carrier on-time %).

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, commerce, marketing, or related discipline
  • Minimum 2-3 yearâs experience in account management, sales analysis and support, customer management, or FMCG/consumer goods sales
  • Experience working with major retail grocery chains, wholesale customers, military or distributors
  • Knowledge of retail sales reporting, category management principles, and promotional planning
  • Proactive, collaborative, and adaptable, with a commitment to delivering outstanding customer outcomes
  • Familiarity with syndicated market data (such as Circana/IRI or NielsenIQ) is an advantage
  • Strong commercial awareness and an interest in developing a career in Key Account Management
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines


Special skills required:

  • Open and accessible communication style, with the ability to consistently achieve positive results
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the consumer products industry, the category, brand strategies, competitors, classes of trade, with the ability to apply this knowledge to solve complex problems successfully
  • High level of proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Microsoft Office
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Ability to develop and share business presentations
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret sales data and translate insights into recommendations
  • Excellent people skills with the ability to work well across cross functional teams.
  • Passion for the products and business
  • Results-oriented with a constant sense of urgency; think like an owner and be curious
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment, while maintaining an enthusiastic hunger for business
  • A valid driver's license and willingness to travel to customer locations when required.


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and annual performance incentive
  • Professional development and mentoring from experienced National Account Managers
  • Career progression opportunities within Key Account Management and Sales Leadership
  • A collaborative, high-performing team environment
  • Employee product discounts and wellbeing initiative.
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including paid leave and health benefits


Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with respect and can succeed. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.
